intro: The Woodland Protector is an introductory task in Shadowglen given by the druid Melithar Staghelm. Alerted by the whisperings of forest spirits, Melithar asks you to seek out Tarindrella, an elusive dryad who has unexpectedly returned to the grove. Her presence hints that something troubling stirs beneath the canopy of Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank goodness you are here, adventurer. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.
Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see you found me, young traveler. Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
